trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: It is a brisk, absorbing study, but not without flaws, sits uneasily beside the others.
trap.right: It is a brisk, absorbing study, but not without flaws.
trap.why: Português emenda orações com vírgula; em inglês cada ressalva pede sua própria oração.

fix.wrong: The study is not without flaw.
fix.right: The study is not without flaws.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com litote: “The study has weaknesses.”
rewrite.answer: The study is not without weaknesses.
